title: Car
description: Vehicle listing with make, model, year, specifications, pricing, condition, and features. Used for car rental platforms, vehicle sales, and automotive marketplaces.

make.description: Car manufacturer or brand (e.g., Toyota, BMW, Ford)

type.description: Car type or category (e.g., Sedan, SUV, Hatchback, Convertible)

fuel_type.description: Fuel type (e.g., Gasoline, Diesel, Electric, Hybrid)

mileage.description: Total mileage or odometer reading in kilometers or miles

currency.description: ISO currency code for the price (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

condition.description: Car condition (e.g., new, used, excellent, good, fair)

features.description: Array of car features (e.g., GPS, Bluetooth, Sunroof, Leather Seats)

image.description: URL to the car's main image
